title: Intersperse

inlines.v: INTERSPERSE, verb transitive interspers'. [Latin interspersus; inter, between, and spargo, to scatter.] To scatter or set here and there among other things; as an able argument interspersed with flowers of rhetoric. intersperse shrubs among trees.
